title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.20936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. translated_title: ReAccess：只看一次，借助高效的测试时记忆保持专注
translated_abstract: 尽管近期取得了诸多进展，视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在细粒度视觉理解方面仍存在困难，往往无法有效利用已编码在其视觉表征中的关键证据。现有方法通过重复的视觉处理或显式推理来应对这一局限，但会引入大量计算开销。在本文中，我们提出了ReAccess——一个轻量级框架，通过紧凑的联想记忆来保存并复用与问题相关的视觉证据。该记忆在单次视觉预填充（prefill）过程中构建，支持渐进式的证据检索，从而引导注意力查询和隐藏表征，在不进行重复图像编码或显式推理轨迹的情况下实现有效的视觉定位。大量实验表明，该方法在通用视觉理解和细粒度感知方面均取得了一致的提升，同时实现了显著更快的推理速度。
tldr: ReAccess在单次视觉预填充中构建紧凑联想记忆，通过渐进式检索与问题相关的视觉证据来引导注意力查询和隐藏表征，无需重复图像编码或显式推理即可实现细粒度视觉理解，并大幅提升推理速度。
en_tdlr: ReAccess builds a compact associative memory during a single visual prefill and progressively retrieves question-relevant visual evidence to steer attention queries and hidden representations, enabling fine-grained visual grounding with substantially faster inference without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning.
